name: li-company-formation
description: Prepare a 2026 Liechtenstein entity-formation workpaper under the Persons and Companies Act (PGR), centred on the GmbH, with the AG, Anstalt and foundation capital rules. Covers minimum capital (GmbH CHF 10,000, AG CHF 50,000, Anstalt CHF 30,000 (CHF 50,000 if in shares), foundation CHF 30,000, or the same amounts in EUR or USD), payment and contributions in kind, the standard and simplified GmbH formation routes, registration with the Office of Justice, qualified management and disqualification rules, size classes (micro, small, medium, large), statutory audit or review and the micro-company review waiver, filing annual accounts within 12 months, and the link to the CHF 1,800 minimum tax. Trigger on: Liechtenstein company formation, GmbH gründen Liechtenstein, AG Liechtenstein, Handelsregister, Mindestkapital. Out of scope: trusts, full foundation law, regulated licences, registry fees and incorporation timetables.
